is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae (page 3, 9).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the kdr mutation (L1014F) (page 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper states 'Out of 512 sub-samples analyzed, PCR assay revealed that most of the mosquitoes were highly resistant to pyrethroids and DDT (kdr mutation frequency: trap: 0.96, indoor: 0.93)' (page 9). It provides only the final frequency values, not the raw genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or the number of mosquitoes genotyped per category.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study evaluating the Lehmann Funnel Entry Trap.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Vallée du Kou 3 (VK3) and Vallée du Kou 5 (VK5) (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from July to October (page 1, 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new field evaluation of a specific trap deployment.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not provide the raw genotype counts in the main text or the provided supplementary information.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of Lehmann Funnel Entry Traps (LFETs) on mosquito density in Vallée du Kou, Burkina Faso. While it reports kdr (L1014F) mutation frequencies, it fails to provide the raw genotype counts required for the database.
